plugins.name: burrow
plugins.description: Your own VPN on a server you rent, set up by Claude: VLESS + XHTTP + REALITY plus WireGuard, a web panel with QR enrolment, a watchdog with automatic failover. Two profiles (single server abroad, or relay + exit), chosen by one plain-language question.
